name: Nobody prices the decided rung - the re-base falls back to closes
question: With no live mid on the just-decided period, does Priced re-base onto that contract's last close BEFORE the decision - from the source page when it has one, from the composite when it does not?
notes: RBA: on 31-Aug-26 the tickers were not numbered the way the meeting calendar implies, so the change columns follow the tickers' own recorded dates instead. This is normal after an unscheduled meeting; if there has not been one, the calendar in config/meetings.json needs checking.
